steps.en: Install the sandbox package in your app's language
steps.zh: 按宿主语言安装沙箱包
steps.code: uv add pydantic-monty · npm install @pydantic/monty · cargo add monty

steps.en: Open a pool and check out a session
steps.zh: 开一个池，从里面取出一个会话

steps.en: Spawns a ~2 MB worker subprocess per session — no filesystem, network or env inside
steps.zh: 拉起约 2 MB worker 子进程——里面没有文件、网络与环境变量

steps.en: Feed model-written code plus the host functions it may call
steps.zh: 喂入模型写的代码和允许它调用的宿主函数

steps.en: Runs the Python subset; a host call suspends, runs your function on the host, returns only its result
steps.zh: 执行 Python 子集；宿主调用会暂停、在宿主侧跑你的函数、只回传结果

value.en: Fresh sub-millisecond Python sandboxes per request, inside your own app — no containers to run, and code leaves only through the functions you handed it
value.zh: 每个请求毫秒级开出全新 Python 沙箱，就在你应用里——没有容器要运维，代码只能经你交给它的函数离开

sources: https://github.com/pydantic/monty README — install commands (uv add pydantic-monty / npm install @pydantic/monty / cargo add monty)
https://github.com/pydantic/monty README example — with Monty() as pool / pool.checkout() / session.feed_run(code, inputs=..., external_lookup=...)
https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/concepts/security/ — worker subprocess per session, no ambient authority, host functions run on the host
https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/reference/alternatives/ — ~2 MB worker baseline, 0.8 ms checkout from a warm pool
